An aspect of the invention provides a playing piece, toy, figurine or component having first and second electrically conductive surfaces adapted to be capacitively coupled to playing areas of a playing surface; a memory storing data; means for deriving a power supply from a power supply unit by means of the capacitive coupling of the first and second electrically conductive surfaces to respective different playing areas of the playing surface; and means for supplying data from the memory when a power supply is derived by the deriving means .

An aspect of the invention provides gaming apparatus comprising: means for sensing the presence of a playing piece on a playing area; means for monitoring the time for which a playing piece has been held by a player; and means for determining the future progress of the playing piece in accordance with the monitored time. An aspect of the invention provides gaming apparatus comprising: means for sensing the presence of a playing piece on any one of a plurality of playing areas; means for determining the speed and/or accuracy of movement of a playing piece, for example the speed and/or accuracy of movement between playing areas, in accordance with information provided by the sensing means; and means for determining the future progress of the playing piece in accordance with the determined speed and/or accuracy.

An aspect of the invention provides gaming apparatus comprising: means for sensing the presence of a playing piece on a playing area, and means for determining the
future progress of the playing piece in accordance with at least one of: the status of that playing piece; its location; where the piece is touched by a player; its relationship relative to other playing pieces. An aspect of the intention provides a gaming apparatus comprising means for sensing the presence of a playing piece on a playing area; and means for modifying or changing the rules of a game in accordance with the sensed playing piece. An aspect of the invention provides gaming apparatus comprising means for sensing the presence of playing pieces on a playing area or areas; and means for modifying or changing the rules of a game in accordance with the sensed playing pieces and/or the playing area or areas on which the pieces are sensed.

An aspect of the invention provides a playing piece for use in games apparatus having memory means storing data for modifying or changing at least one of the rules or date relating to a game to be played using the playing piece.

An aspect of the invention provides a playing piece for use in games apparatus having means for receiving a further playing piece and means for allowing data to be supplied from a memory of that further playing piece when power is derived by the playing piece.

An aspect of the invention provides a playing piece or component having means for receiving a further playing piece and means for allowing data related to that further playing piece to be communicated only when the further playing piece is received by said receiving means.

An aspect of the invention provides a playing piece
having a plurality of areas that may be touched by a user and means for supplying different data in accordance with the area touched by the user.

An aspect of the invention provides gaming apparatus comprising at least one playing surface having one or more playing areas; means for sensing a component on a playing area; and at least one component adapted to couple together playing areas or to extend a playing area. The component may be adapted to couple together playing areas on different playing surfaces. The component may comprise first and second electrically conductive surfaces adapted to be capacitively coupled to respective playing area; and means for enabling data communication between the games modules . Throughout this specification and the claims which follow, unless the context requires otherwise, the word "comprise", or variations such as "comprises" or "comprising", will be understood to imply the inclusion of a stated integer or group of integers but not the exclusion of any other integer or group of integers.
Other modifications will be apparent to those skilled in the art.

claim.claim-text: CLAIMS

1. Games apparatus comprising a games module having a playing surface with at least one playing area, the at least one playing area having first electrical coupling means, at least one playing piece having second electrical coupling means for coupling with the first electrical coupling means, the games module having means for supplying a signal to a playing piece electrically coupled to the games module, and the playing piece having a memory means for storing data, means for deriving a power supply from the signal supplied by the games module, the power supply deriving means comprising coupling means for coupling to a user so as to complete an electrical path via the user back to the games module, and means for communicating data between the playing piece and the games module in response to power being derived by the power deriving means from the signal provided by the games module.

2. Games apparatus comprising: a games module having first electrical coupling means and at least one playing piece having second electrical coupling means for coupling with the first electrical coupling means, the games module having means for generating a signal for supply to a playing piece when the playing piece is electrically coupled to the games module, and the playing piece having means for deriving a power supply from the signal supplied by the games module, the power supply deriving means comprising coupling means for coupling to a user so as to complete an electrical path via the user
back to the games module, and communication means for communicating data to at least one of a user and the games module in response to power being derived by the power deriving means from the signal provided by the games module.
3. Apparatus according to claim 2, wherein the playing piece has a memory and the communication means is arranged to communicate data between the memory and the games module.

4. Apparatus according to claim 1, 2 or 3, wherein said coupling means is arranged to couple to a user so as to complete an electrical path via the user back to the games module when the user makes contact with or is in close proximity to the playing piece.
5. Apparatus according to claim 1, 2, 3 or 4, wherein the first and second electrical coupling means are arranged so as to couple capacitively to one another or to make a direct ohmic connection.

6. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the communication means is arranged to communicate data from said playing piece to said games module by modulating, for example amplitude modulating, a signal supplied by the games module.

7. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the playing piece carries data for identifying the playing piece to the games module and the
communication means is arranged to communicate said identifying data to the games module.

8. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein at least one of the games module and playing piece is associated with a loudspeaker, at least one of the playing piece and games module stores audio data and means are provided for driving the loudspeaker in accordance with said audio data.

9. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein at least one of the games module and playing piece is associated with a display, at least one of the games module and playing piece stores display data and means are provided for driving the display in accordance with said display data.

10. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the games module has a plurality of first electrical coupling means electrically separated from one another and means for determining when the second electrical coupling means of a playing piece is electrically coupled to a particular one of said first electrical coupling means.

11. Apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein said or each first electrical coupling means is provided beneath an upper layer of the playing surface so that the first and second electrical coupling means are capacitively coupled when a player places the playing piece on the playing surface.

12. Apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the games module has a plurality of playing areas each having a respective different first electrical coupling means and the games module comprises means for determining the location on the playing surface of a playing piece in response to the playing piece being placed on a playing area.

13. Apparatus according to claim 12, wherein the games module comprises means for checking the first electrical coupling means one after another to determine whether a second electrical coupling means of a playing piece is electrically coupled thereto.
14. Apparatus according to claim 13, further comprising multiplexing means for coupling each of the first electrical coupling means to the checking means .

15. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein a plurality of playing pieces are provided and each playing piece carries data for enabling the games module to distinguish that playing piece from the other playing pieces.
16. Apparatus according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the at least one playing piece carries data for modifying the instructions stored in a memory of the games module.

17. A playing piece for use in a games apparatus, the playing piece having the playing piece features set out
in any one of claims 1 to 16.

18. A playing piece according to claim 17, wherein the playing piece carries a number of different second electrical coupling means and the communication means is arranged to communicate different data dependant upon which one of the different second electrical coupling means is coupled with the user.

19. A playing piece for use in a games apparatus, the playing piece having memory means storing a plurality of sets of data and means for communicating a different one of the plurality of sets of data with a user or a games module dependent on which part of the playing piece is coupled to a user.

20. A playing piece according to claim 19, further comprising electrical coupling means for coupling with electrical coupling means of the games module, means for deriving a power supply from a signal supplied by supplying means of the games module in response to a user touching the playing piece, the communicating means being arranged to communicate a particular one of the sets of data, which set is dependent upon where the user touches the playing piece, in response to power being derived by the power deriving means from the signal provided by the games module.
21. A games module having the games module features set out in any one of claims 1 to 16.
22. A games module according to claim 21, comprising means for identifying a playing piece from data stored in a memory of the playing piece.

23. Games apparatus comprising: a playing surface defining at least one playing area having first electrical coupling means; at least one playing piece adapted to be placed on the at least one playing area and having second electrical coupling means for coupling with the first electrical coupling when the playing piece is placed on the playing area; processing means for carrying out instructions relating to a game to be played; first memory means for storing data relevant to a game; means for supplying a signal to a playing piece when the playing piece is electrically coupled to the games module, the at least one playing piece having means for deriving a power supply from the signal supplied by the games module, the power supply deriving means comprising coupling means for coupling to a player so as to complete an electrical path back to the games module when the player places the playing piece on the playing area thereby supplying power to the playing piece; and communication means for communicating data between the playing piece and the processing means in response to the player placing the playing piece on the playing area so that power is derived by the power deriving means from the signal provided by the games module.

24. Games apparatus comprising: a playing surface defining at least one playing area; at least one playing piece or component adapted to be placed on the at least
one playing area; processing means for carrying out instructions relating to a game to be played, the at least one playing piece having memory means storing a plurality of sets of data relevant to a game; and means for communicating one of the sets of data with at least one of a player and the processing means, with the set of data communicated being dependent upon which part of the playing piece is coupled to a player.
25. Apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 16 or 21 to 24 having means for connecting the games module to a games module of another gaming apparatus.
26. Apparatus according to claim 25, wherein the connecting means comprises a component having means for coupling between the playing surfaces of the games modules .
